kind.description: Kind is program for a program; absent for an LLM routine (llm).

enabled.description:
Enabled is whether the routine runs on its schedule after the change
(created routines start disabled; absent for deletes).

hook.description: Hook is true when the change is to a hook (paused or resumed by name).

title: procauto routines pause --json
description: RoutineChange is the output of `routines create/update/delete --json`.
